Requirement: This user shall be able to use the form builder capabilities in order to create / update forms for specialized use
In general terms, the form builder shall allow the user to embed specialized components depending on the mode the form is in

The system shall allow any form to be presented in four different modes:
1. Form Edit Design Mode: used to create the form (Add controls, remove controls, define validation rules for the control, manipulation of field config and properties of the control)
2. Form Edit mode: used to add data to the fields of an output record of an existing form in the system in order to complete a specific intended record, e.g. Purchase Order or LHR, (strictly adding data to an existing controls defined in the parent form)
3. Form Edit mode with design capabilities: used to modify the output record of an existing form for a given use case (Part specifications, Engineering Builds, Equipment, redline..etc.), (able to modify the record to include new controls, or update properties of existing controls)
4. Preview mode, this is a test mode intended to allow the user to simulate the creation of a new record without actually saving the data.
The system shall embed form controls based on the output type selected for a form
The system shall allow the user to customise "field configurations" for a component (such as label, placeholder, row numbers etc)
The system shall give the user the option of implementing rules around form builder components
The system shall display a warning flag specific to the rule set for a component, which will not allow the user to proceed with the form until the deviation that triggered the flag is resolved

The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to set a rule that will generate a flag on that field if a linked field has any value. (eg. if field A linked to field B has any value, field B on which this rule is implemented needs to have some value)

The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to set a rule that will generate a flag on that field if a linked field is blank. (eg. if field A linked to field B is blank, field B on which this rule is implemented needs to have some value)
